title: Shiraishi An — Words For My Partner〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're gonna help us with practice, right, Miku? You won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I know I won't.
By the way, where's Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's busy taking care of animals for her committee, so she's gonna be late.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. We have some time until she gets here I suppose.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, I almost forgot...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We did another STAY GOLDEN and kicked its butt like I said we would!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wish you were there to see it! Especially how Kohane did!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, she was just something else. So good that I almost forgot to sing my own part!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. That must've been incredible.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to think Kohane feels a lot better about herself after what she pulled off...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think I was finally able to actually support her as her partner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But there's a part of me that keeps saying that I would've been able to do this sooner if I had my priorities straight, you know?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure about that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was probably going to be a long process after she took up street music and met all of you guys, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane began singing because of you, An, correct?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means what she knows about your world is entirely based on what you know, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What I know equals what she knows...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Especially what it means to sing well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your singing ability was her starting point. Thus, I thought that it would be a long process for her no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As a result, even though she kept improving, she wasn't able to feel confident about herself until now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So that's why her idea of what counts as good felt so off sometimes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. For example, what we practice each day. Currently, Azusawa works on a list of things we prepared for her...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's mostly just about fundamentals, but that workload also isn't something your average novice can handle.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right... But she was doing all sorts of stuff even before you guys set that up for her, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. She seemed eager to do more, so we slowly gave her more and more things to work on...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does she even know how heavy her workload actually is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I knew it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it's true. Conversely, she may be under the impression that she's not doing enough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It also doesn't help that she's seen Akito and I handle even heavier loads.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So Miku was right. Kohane thinks this is normal because of us...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Correct.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She just kept getting better and better, and just brushed off what we practiced like it was nothing so I never really thought about it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But she really thinks this is just how things are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does that make her some kind of glee monster?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Maybe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Can't you call her something a little nicer?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But someone told her that she needs to commit and have more confidence in herself, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. It'll be better for Kohane if she figured that out on her own, huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She may've been so desperate to catch up with you guys that she never gave herself a chance to see how she was doing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For better or worse, her world, her SEKAI is only about Vivid BAD SQUAD right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It also means that you guys mean that much to her, so I suppose it may not be as closed off as I'm saying it may be...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But in your world, that's not the case, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think it's great how she's performing in events and singing all on her own now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wasn't that just about getting more experience and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, and I believe that she benefitted in that way as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I think her gaining some independence gave her an opportunity to see your world through her own eyes and not just yours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Through her own eyes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just as her meeting you, An, and becoming interested in the street music scene opened doors for her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Meeting others will also start opening doors for her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know who this person is, but the advice they gave her might end up being one of the best things that's happened to her, no?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right...
Yeah, that totally makes sense!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I promised to ask about who that person was, but never really got around to it.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, where is she...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She does seem to be running very late. Maybe we should call her...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait... Crap!
She messaged me earlier.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I'm hurrying but it's still gonna take me a while, so please start without me.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then let's do that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll tell her that she can take her time and doesn't have to rush.
